It is 114 foil cards (57 per side): 87 very rare foils, 25 super rare foils, and 2 ultra rare foils ([[Darth Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker]]). Displays shipped with oversized, non-playable objective box toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus random reprints from earlier expansions. Those reprints are not listed here. A foil of a title not on this list is not a Reflections pack foil.
